scope: Supplementary ordinary Lean TCP binding parity on Linux x64, followed by unchanged upstream TCP/HTTP regressions. Not full API/suite or cross-platform conformance.
implementation: Private POSIX socket setup preserves a live bound fd across listen/connect.
Pinned libuv bind/name/keepalive error behavior, including deferred EADDRINUSE.
Engine event-loop stream IO after fd handoff; Deno read restart and Bun connect-event adoption handled privately.
No Lasm Lean declarations or annotations added.

hostAndApplicationTests.lifetimeScope: Each engine: 100 bound/failed-bind resources and 10 connected pairs, including bound and unbound clients, without OS socket-descriptor growth.

upstream.configuration: v39 TCP host, eight prestarted workers, explicit Linux stack adjustment

limits: Windows still uses deferred binding; its native socket handoff remains open.
The POSIX implementation contains macOS ABI handling but has only been executed on Linux x64.
The Bun raw-fd path is engine-specific and requires continued version/OS validation.
Other error, cancellation, timing, and networking edge cases remain unverified.
The Deno HTTP pass does not erase the older intermittent early-streaming failure.
The full upstream suite is still incomplete.
